from tslearn.metrics.dtw_variants import njit_sakoe_chiba_mask
import numpy as np

sz1, sz2 = 5, 5
radius = 1

# Generate the Sakoe-Chiba band mask
mask = njit_sakoe_chiba_mask(sz1, sz2, radius)

# Verify the shape of the generated mask
assert mask.shape == (sz1, sz2), f"Unexpected shape: {mask.shape}"

# In tslearn, DTW masks use 0.0 for valid cells and inf for invalid cells.
# For a 5x5 matrix with radius 1, the valid cells are the diagonal and one cell on each side.
# Valid cells per row: 2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 = 13.
# Invalid cells: 25 - 13 = 12.
invalid_count = int(np.isinf(mask).sum())
valid_count = int((mask == 0.).sum())

assert invalid_count == 12, f"Expected 12 invalid cells, got {invalid_count}"
assert valid_count == 13, f"Expected 13 valid cells, got {valid_count}"

print(f"__CHECK__ njit_sakoe_chiba_mask {mask.shape} {invalid_count}")
